# The connected-system mental model

Reference ID: `connected-system-mental-model` · Version: 2026-10-09 · Topics: mental_model, value

How to reason in SoftwareDLC: model durable claims, connect evidence, separate semantic identity from presentation, and use projections for focused work.

## Reasoning principles

Section ID: `reasoning-principles` (principles)

Model durable claims rather than every incidental detail.
Prefer meaningful relationships; keep labels, classification, and ownership as metadata when they are not semantic edges.
Keep semantic identity separate from presentation, layout, filters, and projections.
Honor the project’s document authority; connect source, tests, and runtime evidence to graph claims without silently superseding accepted requirements.
Use bounded projections to answer focused product, story, architecture, interface, data-flow, or change questions.
Keep AI and human proposals isolated until validation, comparison, and explicit user acceptance.
